description: This file defines an abstract PHP class 'Message' for representing HTTP messages within the AWS CRT (C Runtime) library. It manages HTTP method, path, query parameters, headers, and serialization/deserialization functions.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: An abstract class representing an HTTP message, capable of serialization and deserialization, managing headers, and storing HTTP method, path, and query parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an HTTP message with method, path, query parameters, and headers, and creates the underlying native message resource.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Releases the native message resource upon object destruction.

methods.name: toBlob
methods.description: Serializes the HTTP message into a binary blob for transmission.

methods.name: marshall
methods.description: Converts an HTTP message object into a string buffer suitable for transmission.

methods.name: _unmarshall
methods.description: Creates an HTTP message object from a serialized buffer, parsing method, path, query parameters, and headers.

methods.name: pathAndQuery
methods.description: Constructs the full request path including URL-encoded query parameters.

methods.name: method
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method of the message.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Returns the query parameters as an associative array.
